scope: Full source-selected adaptation: M1/M2 explicit frequency branches removed in spatial; M3 retained. Each before endpoint is its own architecture/order-seed source fit; after is that fit plus its own source136 intervention selection and adaptation (planned 6 epochs/54 steps). Same source-fit1205 data; source-adapt136 is separate from fit. Fixed 16 references. Only layer3.5.conv1/2/3 are trained in adaptation; all remaining parameters including M1/M2/M3 heads are frozen but participate in differentiable computation. Each teacher independently selects interventions, so the final comparison includes selection differences and does NOT isolate their contribution from architecture or adaptation. Seeds 17/29/43 vary BOTH source-fit and adaptation data order with the same initialization, NOT independent initializations. Development160 is reused development, NOT a new blind test; expanded3075 is also a historical cohort. No target-based parameter selection. OA/BA are percentages and deltas percentage points. BA averages present classes; absent classes are blank, not zero. NLL uses natural logs and Brier sums over all eight classes. SD is sample SD across the three order seeds. Repeated seed events, ships, passes and reference exposures are not independent samples. Paired outcome changes and selected image cases do not establish a physical mechanism.

coverage.availability_rule: input.prepare_view: view is not None and valid_target; cached per observation/polarization
coverage.reference_rule: fixed supplied bank after native same-ID/MMSI exclusion; internal forward use requires runner receipt

selection.note: Final useful is used for selection intersections. choice_useful is the earlier screen; non-useful fallback interventions are not selected teachers. Same source observations repeated across seeds are repeated exposure, not independent evidence.

rival_rule: Strongest nontruth class of mean legacy_before logits across order seeds, fixed for each query
alignment: 24 prediction archives joined by unique ID and validated against cohort labels

pass_bootstrap.method: Paired pass-cluster percentile bootstrap; resample whole passes equally with replacement, keep all observations and paired fixed model seeds; then average seed deltas
pass_bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional cohort uncertainty for these six fixed fitted models; NOT independent-training confidence, NOT a fresh-test claim
pass_bootstrap.ba_rule: Average classes present in each resample; absent-class replicates explicitly counted
